source_text: Et dominamini piscium maris et volatilium caeli et iumentorum et universae terrae. Dominium istud spiritaliter: cogitationibus quae de profundo (pisces), volatilibus sensibus, iumentis et bestiis passionum. Si mens principatur, imago Dei regnat; si caro, bestiae dominantur in nobis.
pass_a_gloss: And rule of-fishes of-sea and of-birds of-heaven and of-cattle and of-whole earth. Dominion that spiritually: to-thoughts which from depth (fishes), to-flying senses, to-cattle and to-beasts of-passions. If mind rules, image of-God reigns; if flesh, beasts rule in us.
pass_b_english: [[And rule the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the cattle and the whole earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:28]]. That dominion, spiritually: over thoughts from the deep (fish), over winged senses, over cattle and beasts of the passions. If the mind holds first place, God’s image reigns; if the flesh does, beasts rule in us.
